cyclical_demand_reason: Mostly public road, highway and airport work funded by state and federal agencies; maintenance and resurfacing are essential and stable.
big_ticket_reason: Highway, runway and road construction projects are large, infrequent contracts for agencies and developers.
people_delivered_reason: Paving revenue depends on plants, materials and heavy equipment, not just staff time; it is vertically integrated construction.
large_customers_reason: Main customers are state and federal agencies, municipalities, airports and military installations, plus private developers.
asset_heavy_reason: Owns hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, liquid asphalt terminals and paving equipment fleets requiring ongoing capital investment.

offers_products_reason: Makes and sells packaged shelf-stable and frozen foods under 50+ brands like Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega, Cream of Wheat.
offers_services_reason: Only sells branded packaged food; no services offered as a main offering.
sells_to_consumers_reason: Branded foods chosen by household shoppers at grocery stores; website speaks to families and consumers.
sells_to_organizations_reason: Sells to grocery retailers, mass merchants, club stores and foodservice customers who buy for resale.
recurring_revenue_reason: Repeat orders of pantry staples and food by retailers and households, such as canned vegetables, spices and oils.
cyclical_demand_reason: Packaged groceries are staples; demand holds up in recessions, with possible trade-down to private label.
big_ticket_reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased grocery items such as canned goods, spices and syrup.
people_delivered_reason: Value is in manufactured branded food products, not staff time.
large_customers_reason: Ultimate buyers are households; retailers are large but the consumer brand model points to no.
asset_heavy_reason: Operates manufacturing plants and distribution facilities for food production, needing ongoing capital investment.
notes: Large_customers is borderline because major grocery chains and Walmart are big buyers, but consumers are the end market.

offers_products_reason: Sells software products: dealer websites, inventory and digital retailing tools, and the Cars.com listings platform.
offers_services_reason: Provides online marketplace listings, digital advertising and lead generation to car dealers and automakers.
sells_to_consumers_reason: Car shoppers use the site free; dealers and automakers are the paying buyers who choose the products.
sells_to_organizations_reason: Main customers are car dealerships and automotive manufacturers buying listings, advertising and software.
recurring_revenue_reason: Dealers pay monthly subscriptions for listings and software, usually under ongoing contracts.
cyclical_demand_reason: Dealers and automakers can cut advertising and marketing spend when car sales weaken.
big_ticket_reason: Dealers pay modest recurring monthly subscription fees, not large one-off purchases.
people_delivered_reason: Customers pay for the online marketplace platform, traffic and software, not mainly staff time.
large_customers_reason: Main customers are thousands of franchise and independent dealerships, many small, plus some automakers.
asset_heavy_reason: Online platform business needing software and people, not plants, fleets or properties.
notes: Consumers use the site free, so consumer buyer answer is a judgment call.

offers_products_reason: Manufactures and sells DURA-BASE composite mats and EPZ grounding systems, also offered for purchase.
offers_services_reason: Matting rental, installation, site planning, logistics and remediation services are core; rental fleet is the larger part.
sells_to_consumers_reason: Customers are utilities, pipeline, energy and construction project owners, not households.
sells_to_organizations_reason: Rents and sells matting to utilities, energy companies, pipeline and construction contractors.
recurring_revenue_reason: Mat rentals and installations are project-based, tied to individual construction or energy projects, though repeat customers exist.
cyclical_demand_reason: Demand depends on energy, utility and construction project spending, which can be deferred in downturns.
big_ticket_reason: Mostly project rentals and services rather than large infrequent purchases, though mat sales can be sizable.
people_delivered_reason: Value comes mainly from the composite mat fleet and manufactured product, not staff time.
large_customers_reason: Main customers are large utilities, pipeline and energy companies, and major contractors.
asset_heavy_reason: Owns a large rental fleet of composite mats plus manufacturing operations needing ongoing capital investment.
notes: Mix of rental, sales and services; the rental/service share is judged larger from the website text.
